explanation:
getgid32() returns the real group ID of the calling process, supporting 32-bit IDs. It was added to handle larger group ID values compared to the original 16-bit version.

**Related System Calls:** `getresgid()`, `setgid()`, `setregid()`
example_explanation: This example demonstrates the basic usage of the getgid32() system call. returns 0 on success or -1 on error with errno set appropriately.
